newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman shares inch up in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman shares inch up in moderate trade.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange ticked up in moderate trade in the week to Wednesday dominated once again by banking and investment stocks, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The stock market index inched up to 329.09 points from 328.72 points a week earlier.
Total trade value amounted to 27.3 million rials down from 28.8 million rials last week while the number of shares traded was steady at 6.9 million.
Of the 76 stocks traded, 28 rose, 38 declined and 10 were unchanged.
Some 293,000 shares of the National Bank of Oman worth 2.5 million rials were traded. The stock closed at 8.350 rials compared with last week's 8.340.
Some 1.2 million shares of Alliance Housing Bank worth 2.97 million rials changed hands. The stock dipped to 1.970 rials from 2.070 last week.
National Biscuit Industries closed at 6.500 rials from 6.100 rials a week earlier.
Al Shalman Securities ended the week at 5.620 rials compared with 5.350 rials.
Banking and investment shares accounted for 91 percent of trade, followed by industrials with five percent, services with three percent and insurance stocks with one percent. ($1=0.377 rials)
